Spark driver JVM heap (default 6g, sized for a real cluster node — lower this on a small/shared instance, e.g. a single g4dn.xlarge running master+worker+kitchen together, where the default can starve the JVM gateway during SparkContext init)

How to run this pipeline. 'service': force the HTTP waiter/kitchen path (docs/MODEL_CONTAINER_ISOLATION.md Option B) — needs the pipeline's manifest service_url actually reachable; errors out if not. 'cluster': force in-process execution (Option A) on whatever Spark cluster --master points at — every executor on that cluster needs this pipeline's own deps installed (torch/transformers/etc., see models/pipelines/<name>/requirements.txt), not just the driver. 'auto' (default): unchanged existing behavior — use the service if its host resolves from wherever this process runs, else in-process. Explicit modes exist because 'auto' silently depends on network topology (which container you happen to run this from), not on which Spark cluster --master actually points at — pick 'cluster' explicitly to run a pipeline on a bigger/different cluster than its manifest's own dedicated one, regardless of whether the kitchen server also happens to be reachable from there.

files.doc: ner_translate model server — the "kitchen" in the waiter/kitchen split (see docs/MODEL_CONTAINER_ISOLATION.md Option B). Wraps this pipeline's existing load()/run(loaded, paths) contract (pipeline.py) behind one HTTP endpoint, so Spark workers never need torch/CUDA/gliner/transformers in their own Python environment — they just POST a list of file paths (already on the same mounted volume this server reads from) and get back the same {filename: result} shape pipeline.run() always returned.
Example BYOM plugin — a stand-in for a user-supplied model file.

Benchmark metrics publisher — bridges the existing benchmark output (results/raw_results.json, produced by benchmark/run_benchmark.py, see its `generate_report()`/`main()`) into CloudWatch, and optionally archives both report files to S3.

cli.help: Publish current results once and exit
If set, uploads results/raw_results.json and metrics_report.md to this bucket on every new run (defaults to $ARTIFACTS_BUCKET env var).
